concepts.gloss_en: the imaginative faculty (koach ha-medameh) is clarified and rectified (through the spread of prophecy)

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are the identical clause from the same sentence in lm2:8 — 'through the spread of prophecy the imaginative faculty is clarified and rectified.' The only difference between the two surface forms is the added qualifier 'בחינת כח' (the aspect/power of), which is descriptive expansion of the same phrase, not a different word or concept. Safe merge.
